title: [ci/cd][nightly] windows-arm64-binary-wheel - ModuleNotFound errors
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Errors since last Thursday (see [here](https://hud.pytorch.org/hud/pytorch/pytorch/nightly/1?per_page=50&name_filter=windows-arm64)) 

```
ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement intel-openmp==2025.1.1; platform_system == "Windows" (from torch) (from versions: none)
ERROR: No matching distribution found for intel-openmp==2025.1.1; platform_system == "Windows"
 Running python rnn_smoke.py...
 Traceback (most recent call last):
   File "C:\a\pytorch\pytorch/pytorch\.ci\pytorch\test_example_code\rnn_smoke_win_arm64.py", line 6, in <module>
    import torch
 ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'torch'
 ##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.
```
cc: @atalman @malfet @seemethere 

### Versions

wheel-py3_11, py3_12, py3_13

cc @seemethere @malfet @atalman @peterjc123 @mszhanyi @skyline75489 @nbcsm @iremyux @Blackhex
